text:
Maria: Hypatia legal flagged the model variant + adapter flow. They want to run Zephyrus-34b with their custom adapter/tokenizer in our catalog. Can we confirm compatibility?
Ajay: @maria quick Q — do they need KV-cache for long-context chat or just embeddings/QA? That affects variant selection and quantization.
Maria: Long-context chat (~64k). They also asked about on-prem private deployment later, but initial POC is hosted. Security cares about KMS + audit logs.
Samir: 64k is fine but Zephyrus-34b quantized int8/4bit + adapter may break KV cache offsets. Need a validation pass.
Lucy: Hypatia is price-sensitive. If we require dedicated capacity because of 64k, that's a pricing delta. Need to surface to AE.
Maria: Noted. @lucy can you add pricing delta to deal tracker? I want eng to triage compatibility first.
Ajay: I'll run a fast compatibility matrix today. Need the adapter artifact and tokenizer metadata. @maria pls share upload link.
Maria: Uploading now to /shared/hypatia/zephyrus-adapter.tar.gz :link:
Maria: Also adding their security contact for the questionnaire: security@hypatia.ai
deploy-bot: model-scan started for zephyrus-34b (run id z34b-2026-03-21-01)
Ajay: Quick note — for retention of 64k KV we need to enable chunked KV streaming. We'll simulate with a 8k->64k ramp and check latency.
Samir: For hosted POC, we can keep them on preemptible pools but SLA will be best-effort. If they need predictable 64k throughput, recommend Dedicated. I'll draft cost numbers.
Lucy: Hypatia asked about encryption in transit + KMS key ownership. We support customer-managed keys for Private deployments, but hosted requires platform KMS. Legal flagged that as a blocker.
Maria: Hypatia prefers hosted first; legal will accept hosted if we sign an Addendum allowing SOC2 + encryption at rest and a clause for key rotation. Can sales get an SLA note?
Ajay: Technical midterm blockers: adapter uses nonstandard token IDs (>50280) and a custom eos token. We need to ensure our tokenizer mapping patch applied at load time. I can patch loader to remap tokens.
Maria: If that's doable in <48h we can keep timeline. Hypatia wants a live POC demo next Tuesday.
Ajay: I'll try to get a patched loader + small repro by EOD. If patched loader can't remap efficiently, fallback is to run on Private with their tokenizer preinstalled.
Samir: Also flagging memory: Zephyrus-34b 64k contexts on an 80GB GPU with kv caching will need kv-sharding across 2 GPUs or quantization to 4-bit + offload. That increases infra complexity.
Lucy: I'll prep a slide for pricing scenarios: hosted (best-effort), hosted + dedicated burst, private (customer-managed KMS). Hypatia can choose.
Maria: Thanks team. Action items:
- Ajay: compatibility run + patched loader (ETA today)
- Samir: cost sketch for Dedicated and infra constraints (ETA tomorrow)
- Lucy: update deal tracker and prep pricing slide (ETA tomorrow)
I copied Hypatia sec contact and will keep them updated. :thumbsup:
Ajay: starting run now, will post logs. If anyone wants to pair, I'm online at 14:30 PST.
Samir: noted, will sync after Ajay posts perf numbers.
Lucy: +1
Maria: great — keep thread updated. Thanks!
